metrics.answer: The President of the United States is Donald Trump, who took office in January 2025. The sources I searched didn't return results for this, so this answer is from my own knowledge and may be out of date.

metrics.answer: The president of the United States is Donald Trump, who assumed office on January 20, 2025 [1]. The president is the head of state and head of government, indirectly elected to a four-year term [1][2].
